component_specifications.TimerRingCard.jsx: Interactive central work timer widget with live ticking seconds, live Shekel income counter based on current rate multiplier (100%/125%/150%/200%), start/pause/stop buttons, break timer, and manual override dialog.
component_specifications.ActivityRingsWidget.jsx: 4 concentric animated SVG rings representing Daily Hours, Overtime, Earnings ₪, and Monthly Target. Interactive hover tooltips showing exact percentages and totals.
component_specifications.InteractiveCalendar.jsx: Full monthly calendar supporting Israeli work weeks (Sunday - Thursday / Friday half-day). Custom colored day pills for Work, Holiday, Half-Day, Vacation, Sick, and Unpaid Leave.
component_specifications.ShiftLogEditorModal.jsx: Modal to log or edit work shifts with exact segments: 100% standard hours (first 8/8.4h), 125% (next 2 hours), 150% (beyond 10h), 200% (Shabbat/Holidays), travel allowance (נסיעות), meal bonus, and custom notes.
component_specifications.AnalyticsDashboard.jsx: Detailed charts (Recharts) for Gross vs Net salary estimation using Israeli Credit Points (נקודות זיכוי), income tax tiers, Bituah Leumi / Health Tax deduction estimates, breakdown of overtime income, and monthly projections.
component_specifications.AIChatAssistant.jsx: Claude-inspired natural language chat assistant ('ShiftBot') capable of configuring Israeli holidays, custom work hours, rate rules, auto-fill absences, and providing breakdown summaries in Russian.
component_specifications.SettingsPanel.jsx: Complete customization suite: Base hourly rate (₪/hr), overtime threshold hours (8h / 8.4h / 9h), custom holiday manager, Israeli tax credit points slider (default 2.25 for men, 2.75 for women), and dark/light theme switch.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js and .jsx files) as specified by the project stack.
Implement the UI in Russian as requested by the user choices.
Ensure full responsiveness: Mobile view uses a sleek floating bottom tab bar with 4-5 tabs (Дашборд, Календарь, Статистика, ИИ Чат, Настройки) while Desktop view uses a floating Apple-glass sidebar.

ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, timer controls, calendar cells, chat inputs) MUST contain a role-based data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='start-work-button', data-testid='theme-toggle-button', data-testid='shift-rate-selector').
Include both Light and Dark theme options using Tailwind dark: modifier classes and root theme toggle state.

Implement accurate Israeli work law defaults: ₪ Shekel currency, Sunday-to-Thursday standard week, 125% for first 2 overtime hours, 150% for subsequent hours, 200% for Shabbat/Holidays, and Credit Points (נקודות זיכוי) tax estimation.
Never use generic centered layouts or plain flat borders without glassmorphism/blur depth.
Use sonner for toast feedback (shift started, shift ended, AI configuration saved, settings updated).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid generic SaaS blue templates. Use high-contrast Apple glassmorphism, concentric SVG Activity Rings, vibrant indicator glows, and smooth spring-like micro-animations.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility_and_contrast: Ensure all text on translucent glass surfaces maintains high contrast against background elements (minimum 4.5:1 ratio).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_readiness: Every clickable, toggleable, or display element MUST have `data-testid` attributes.
